topic: Reject missing early-exit retry evidence before starting resumed work
sourceTrace: The old incoming path accepted4/5/7-field rows and defaulted missing retryUsed=false, even though current producers publish seven explicit fields. The phase preflight checked outer identity and row-count bounds only.
Adoption separately reread CBE_Cortex_ClearEarlyExits after operation startup. It could skip rows whose actor/row could not be retained without marking an unfinished exit.
Existing resume commit already rechecks captured phase receipts before OperationStart. Adoption can consume that same admitted receipt, retaining original native ownership/arrival checks.
implementation: Add pure CHECK mode to BuildingEarlyExitJournal. It validates the exact expected visit identity, at most eight full seven-field rows, no unset fields, non-null unique original actor IDs and known pre-discovered entry membership. One bounded CHECK-to-PUBLIC conversion reuses the existing row type/vector/state/clock/explicit retry validator. No source mutation or native command.

CortexClearBuilding phase preflight calls CHECK with the existing discovered security entries. Malformed/truncated/mismatched data sets resumePhasePending and returns before operation startup, generation changes, durable order consumption or release. The existing commit equality check still binds the admitted receipt.

Adoption uses the captured preflight receipt instead of a later independent public-variable read, requires count7 and directly destructures retryUsed/entry/watch with no defaults. Existing per-actor native MOVE/WAIT/hold and actor/geometry/context checks remain.
An admitted row/actor that cannot be retained marks private egressFailed instead of silently dropping unfinished exit work. This grants no command, stop, replacement membership or extra budget.
cost: One bounded preflight validation/private conversion over at most8 rows and up to16 existing entrance nodes; no second geometry discovery or historical observation scan. Adoption adds one lookup in the existing seven-receipt capture and records failure only on refusal. No worker, timer, new public channel or deadline renewal. Actual5percent median/10percent p95 unmeasured.
limits: CHECK validates data/identity, not authenticated producer provenance, exact physical arrival or native-ready/all-writer quiescence. Public variables remain separately delivered; full sealed replay still unfinished.

Incoming null or identity-less early actors defer rather than infer original identity from another actor. Source capture can retain keyed historical deleted records, but authoritative incoming retirement/adoption of those records remains separate unfinished work.
Absent journals remain a full-delivery ambiguity; this change rejects malformed nonempty early data and does not fabricate an empty zero-budget proof.
Motion/view/follow-through source components are still not consumed by an authenticated successor. Reserve/yield/relief and native/settings/interruption/retirement domains remain required.
Actual normal/HC/JIP/Zeus migration, flow/casualty/repeats, balance and performance remain unverified. Audits paused.
